summary: Arbe Robotics Ltd., via Form 6-K, announced quarterly results and a CFO transition. Karine Pinto-Flomenboim resigned as CFO effective August 30, 2026, succeeded by Assaf Pereg, former SVP Finance at Ibex Medical Analytics and previously Global VP Finance at Nano Dimension. The resignation is a voluntary departure tied to routine succession; the new CFO brings extensive finance leadership. No financial terms, premiums, or strategic actions were disclosed. This is a standard officer change, not an abrupt or forced exit, but the event is explicitly highlighted in the filing. What to watch: whether the transition signals broader strategic shifts or operational challenges.
